import hashlib,json,subprocess,sys,uuid
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/home/joey/GIT/background-file-mover-testing')
gate=Path(sys.argv[1]);out=Path(sys.argv[2])
assert not out.exists()
r=json.loads((gate/'report.json').read_text());assert r['status']=='PASSED' and r['build_mode']=='production'
image=r['config']['runtime'];samples=[]
for profile in ['debug','release']:
 artifacts=r['profiles'][profile]['artifacts']
 matches=[x for x in artifacts if x['test'] and '-file_mover-' in x['name'] and 'password::tests::measured_fixed_profile_hash_and_verify' in (gate/(x['name']+'.test')).read_text()];assert len(matches)==1,matches
 a=matches[0];exe=gate/a['name'];assert hashlib.sha256(exe.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==a['sha256']
 name='file-mover-password-proof-'+uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]
 container=None;cleanup=None
 try:
  c=subprocess.run(['podman','create','--pull=never','--network=none','--cap-drop=ALL','--security-opt=no-new-privileges','--user','1000:1001','--env','LD_BIND_NOW=1','--name',name,'--entrypoint','/bin/sh',image,'-c','exec sleep infinity'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30);assert c.returncode==0,c.stderr;container=c.stdout.strip()
  c=subprocess.run(['podman','cp',str(exe),container+':/proof'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=60);assert c.returncode==0,c.stderr
  c=subprocess.run(['podman','start',container],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30);assert c.returncode==0,c.stderr
  copied=subprocess.run(['podman','exec',container,'sha256sum','/proof'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30);assert copied.returncode==0 and copied.stdout.split()[0]==a['sha256']
  custody=subprocess.run(['podman','exec',container,'cat','/proc/self/status'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30);assert custody.returncode==0
  status={line.split(':',1)[0]:line.split(':',1)[1].strip() for line in custody.stdout.splitlines() if ':' in line}
  assert status['Uid'].split()==['1000']*4 and status['Gid'].split()==['1001']*4 and int(status['CapEff'],16)==0 and status['NoNewPrivs']=='1'
  c=subprocess.run(['podman','exec',container,'/proof','--exact','password::tests::measured_fixed_profile_hash_and_verify','--nocapture','--test-threads=1'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=60);assert c.returncode==0,c.stderr
  assert '1 passed; 0 failed' in c.stdout and 'ADMIN_PASSWORD_PROOF' in c.stdout and 'ADMIN_PASSWORD_PROCESS_HIGH_WATER' in c.stdout,c.stdout
  samples.append({'profile':profile,'executable':a['name'],'sha256':a['sha256'],'exit_code':c.returncode,'runtime_sha256':copied.stdout.split()[0],'custody':{k:status[k] for k in ['Uid','Gid','CapEff','NoNewPrivs']},'stdout':c.stdout,'stderr':c.stderr})
 finally:
  if container:
   c=subprocess.run(['podman','rm','--force',container],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30);cleanup=c.returncode
  if samples and samples[-1]['profile']==profile:samples[-1]['cleanup_exit_code']=cleanup
 assert cleanup==0
out.write_text(json.dumps({'status':'PASSED','driver_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'gate_report_sha256':hashlib.sha256((gate/'report.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'runtime':image,'samples':samples,'limits':['One isolated process observation per profile; not a statistical benchmark, per-allocation memory result, worker/control responsiveness or OS quota qualification.','Disposable fixture only; no account or listener activation.']},indent=2)+'\n')
print(out.read_text())
